title: Healthy habits
examples: What is the best way to wash my hands?
How many times should I brush my teeth?
What foods help me grow strong?

explain.say: Today we learn about being healthy every day. Let us start with washing our hands.

draw.text: Wash hands with soap and water.

explain.say: First you wet your hands with running water. Then you put some soap on your hands. Next you rub your hands together really well for twenty seconds.

items: Rub hands well for twenty seconds

explain.say: After scrubbing, you rinse all the soap off your hands. Then you dry them with a clean towel. This keeps germs away from you.
Next we learn about brushing our teeth every morning. You need a little bit of toothpaste on your brush. Brush in small circles on all your teeth.
Remember to brush your tongue too. This helps keep your breath fresh. Eating healthy foods gives you energy to play.
When you play at the park, you might touch a slide handle. Washing your hands after that keeps germs from getting into your body.

faq.q: When should I wash my hands?
faq.a: You should wash your hands before you eat food. You should also wash them after using the toilet.
asks: When do I wash my hands?
What is the right time to wash hands?

faq.q: How long should I brush my teeth?
faq.a: You should brush your teeth for two minutes every day. This cleans all the little bits of food.
asks: Do I brush for a minute or two?

faq.a: Food groups help us eat a balanced meal. We need things like fruits, vegetables, and grains to grow big.
asks: What kinds of food are good?
Can you name the food groups?

faq.a: Sleep helps your body and your brain rest. When you sleep, your body gets ready for the next day.
asks: Why do I need to sleep?

faq.q: What should I do before I eat?
faq.a: You must wash your hands with soap and water. This washes away tiny germs you might pick up.
asks: Do I wash hands before meals?

facts: Washing hands removes germs from your skin.
Brushing teeth helps keep your mouth healthy.
Eating fruits and vegetables gives you vitamins.
Getting enough sleep helps you learn and play.

quiz.say: After playing outside, what should you do first?
quiz.why: You wash your hands to take away any dirt or germs from playing.

wrong.0: Napping helps you rest, but it does not wash away germs.
wrong.2: Brushing teeth is for cleaning your mouth, not your hands.
wrong.3: Eating a snack does not clean off germs from your skin.

quiz.say: If you want strong bones, which food group should you eat?
quiz.why: Vegetables give you important nutrients that help your bones grow strong.

wrong.0: Fruits are good too, but veggies have different things for bones.
wrong.1: Sweets have too much sugar and are not as good for bones.
wrong.2: Grains give energy, but veggies are better for bones specifically.

quiz.say: What is the best time to brush your teeth?
quiz.show: Morning only or twice a day?
quiz.why: You should brush in the morning and before you go to sleep to keep them clean.

wrong.0: Brushing only in the morning leaves your teeth dirty overnight.
wrong.1: You need to brush in the morning to start your day fresh.
wrong.2: You should brush every day, even when your teeth feel fine.
